allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands Limited has informed the Exchange about outcome of the Board Meeting for formulation, adoption and implementation of Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands Limited Employee Stock Options & Performance Stock Options Scheme 2026.

allot.text: Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of Non-Convertible Debentures
